# Interactive Text Destruction

Demo for the tutorial where you'll learn how to create an interactive 3D text effect where letters explode into dynamic shapes using Three.js, WebGPU, and Three Shader Language (TSL).

![Image Title](https://tympanus.net/codrops/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-2025-07-22-at-09.32.11.jpg)

[Article on Codrops](https://tympanus.net/codrops/?p=96654)

[Demo](https://tympanus.net/Tutorials/InteractiveTextDestruction/)

## Installation

## setup

```
npm i
```

## run

```
npx vite
```
